name_reason: Name accurately reflects purpose (game-clear credit-roll scroll-row thresholds that trigger ending SFX + palette swaps) and data type (const int array). No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix matching 0x5204e or any data address). The 15 is the array dimension, captured in the C declaration not the name. Decompiler names the consuming index/counter music_idx/music_step, reinforcing the 'music' descriptor. The 'chapter' element of the data_fd2_chapter_ prefix is the chtab.c file-grouping convention (chapter/game-lifecycle dispatch tables); mildly imprecise since this table is not chapter-indexed, but not wrong enough to force a rename rippling through globals.h + aniend.c + chtab.c. Name is used consistently across all three files.
purpose: Const table of descending scroll-row threshold values that drive the GAME-CLEAR credit-roll ending SFX and palette swaps.
logic_summary: Copied (15 x 4B = 60B) onto the caller's stack in fd2_play_ending_and_record_clear @ 0x1F894. During the credit-roll countdown loop the panel scrolls from row 0x217 (535) down to 0; each iteration compares the signed scroll-row counter against music_trigger_frames[music_idx]; on a match it fires the ending SFX (FDOTHER.DAT[0x4D] bank) and swaps the palette (FDOTHER.DAT[0x66]), then advances music_idx. The first 14 values (520..22) lie within the loop range and are consumed in descending order; the trailing 1000 (0x3E8) exceeds the 535 loop maximum and is therefore an unreachable sentinel terminator that is never matched.
element_semantics: Each element is a scroll-row index threshold compared against the descending signed scroll counter (iVar4, 0x217..0). Values in source order: 520,430,410,340,310,300,240,180,150,130,110,87,64,22 (descending in-range triggers), then 1000 (out-of-range sentinel/terminator).
notes: Memory at 0x5204e read back byte-for-byte equal to the src initializer (0x208,0x1AE,0x19A,0x154,0x136,0x12C,0xF0,0xB4,0x96,0x82,0x6E,0x57,0x40,0x16,0x3E8). Only 2 xrefs, both from the single caller fd2_play_ending_and_record_clear (READ @ 0x1f8d4, DATA fixup @ 0x1f8cf); zero writers -> const confirmed. Ghidra plate was blank, so a concise data plate was created via run_script_inline (PLATE_COMMENT, transaction-wrapped) reflecting the src conclusion. Source comment in chtab.c was already precise/accurate/ASCII with no process narrative, so chtab.c was left unmodified (no src diff this commit).
